step1_analysis.description: Extracts the base-emitter voltage difference (Delta VBE) from two diode-connected PNP transistors biased at different current densities, and amplifies it using a capacitive feedback amplifier.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Temperature Sensor with a VoltageCalibrated Inaccuracy of ±0.15°C (3σ) From -55 to 125°C

delta_vbe.description: Difference in base-emitter voltage between the two PNPs at 25°C

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard Delta VBE for a 1:5 current ratio at room temperature.

vbe.description: Base-emitter voltage of the PNP at 25°C

sky130_expected.calculation: Standard forward voltage for a diode-connected BJT at ~2uA
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact saturation current (Is) of the PNP model used.
Fundamental physical constant, highly predictable across processes.

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the front-end

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the assumed 2uA and 10uA bias currents for the 1:5 PNP ratio.

midband_gain_db.description: Closed-loop AC gain of the capacitive amplifier

sky130_expected.reasoning: Closed-loop gain is determined by the capacitor ratio C1/C4 in the feedback network.

step3_testbench.description: Measures DC power, Delta VBE temperature coefficient via DC sweep, and closed-loop AC gain of the capacitive front-end.
step3_testbench.spice:
* CMOS Temperature Sensor Front-End Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Generic PNP model for temperature sensing
.model pnp pnp (is=1e-16)

* Parameterized values based on paper metrics
.param CVAL=120f
.param I_UNIT=2u

* DUT Netlist
I2I VDD VIN_N DC {I_UNIT}
I10I VDD VIN_P DC {5*I_UNIT} AC 1u
QR GND GND VIN_N pnp
QL GND GND VIN_P pnp

C1 VIN_P N4 {CVAL}
C2 N3 VIN_N {CVAL}
C3 N4 LABEL_NET_0 {CVAL}
C4 VINT_P N4 {2*CVAL}
C5 VINT_N N3 {2*CVAL}
C6 N3 VIN_N {CVAL}

X1 VINT_P VINT_N N4 N3 amplifier

* Ideal Fully-Differential Amplifier Subcircuit
.subckt amplifier out+ out- in+ in-
E_diff out_diff 0 in+ in- 10000
E_out+ out+ 0 VALUE={0.9 + V(out_diff)/2}
E_out- out- 0 VALUE={0.9 - V(out_diff)/2}
.ends

* DC feedback resistors to prevent floating nodes in AC/DC analysis
R_dc1 VINT_P N4 1G
R_dc2 VINT_N N3 1G

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9

* Differential voltage extractors for AC measurement
E_diff_out diff_out 0 VINT_P VINT_N 1
E_diff_in diff_in 0 VIN_P VIN_N 1

.control
  * 1. Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. Temperature Sweep for Delta VBE
  dc temp -55 125 5
  let dvbe = v(vin_p) - v(vin_n)
  meas dc delta_vbe_25 find dvbe at=25
  meas dc vbe_25 find v(vin_n) at=25
  meas dc delta_vbe_125 find dvbe at=125
  meas dc delta_vbe_m55 find dvbe at=-55
  let tc_delta_vbe = (delta_vbe_125 - delta_vbe_m55) / (125 - (-55))
  print tc_delta_vbe

  * 3. AC Analysis for Closed-Loop Gain
  ac dec 10 1 1Meg
  let gain_db = vdb(diff_out) - vdb(diff_in)
  meas ac midband_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
  
  quit
.endc
.end
